title: Directional differentiation is continuous on local tests
statement: Over $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $m,q\geq0$ be integers, $V\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ open and $v\in\mathbf R^m$. On the local test space $\mathscr D(V,\mathbf R^q)$ [def-sfb-local-coefficient-tests], the directional derivative $f\mapsto(z\mapsto Df(z)[v])$ is a continuous real-linear endomorphism.
